title: Transfer the existing full coupled noncritical shear estimate
statement: On l2 directsum l2 let Gamma=diag(kappa^2 nu D,kappa^2 nu D), B_A=[-i kappa p A J,0;AC,-i kappa p A J0], C=2pi^2 l(S-S^-1)D^-1 Q^-1/2. Li-Wei-Zhang1801.05645v1 equations1.5-1.7/Theorem1.1 cover the forced system. Set X=kappa x, quarter-period transverse shift, nu_prime=kappa^2 nu,k_f=1,gamma=kappa^3 nu A, paper phi=-Q^-1/2 z,omega2=zeta/kappa. These are fixed bounded norm equivalences for noncritical r^2>=2. For each fixed p!=0,l,nu,T>0, the coupled estimate C(1+aT)exp(-aT), a=c3 sqrt(|p gamma|)+nu_prime r^2, tends to zero, and its large-A hypothesis holds. It includes the A-prefactored Squire integral; no nonlinear stability theorem or uniform all-fibre bound is imported.
